title: In a Major Boost for the Right, Another Bolsonaro Nears Brazil’s Presidency
summary_full: Flávio Bolsonaro’s first round lead leaves President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva three weeks to find the votes to stop Brazil’s, and Latin America’s, rightward shift.
